description: Offsets applied to a polyphonic signal as a whole, as a running increment, and channel by channel, in 4HP

params.text: Chooses what the eight knobs below act on: PRI gives each of them one channel, SEC gives each of them a group of channels
Offsets every channel, -10V fully counter-clockwise to +10V fully clockwise
Attenuates and inverts the All offset CV between -100% and +100%, and comes up at 0%
Adds a step of offset that grows by one more step for each channel: nothing on channel 1, one step on channel 2, two on channel 3 and so on, -10V to +10V per step
Attenuates and inverts the incremental offset CV between -100% and +100%, and comes up at 0%
Offsets one channel in PRI mode, or the group of channels named in blue beneath it in SEC mode, -10V to +10V

inputs.text: Adds its voltage to the All offset knob after the trim; a polyphonic signal here offsets each channel by its own amount
Adds its voltage to the incremental offset knob after the trim

outputs.text: Carries the input with every offset applied

notes: with nothing patched the module puts out channels of its own: fix a polyphony on the menu and the offset knobs alone build a chord, transposed by the All offset
in SEC mode several knobs can reach the same channel and their offsets add up, which readily runs past the clipping range
menu: Polyphony: Auto, 1 (monophonic) up to 16 channels — fixes the number of output channels instead of following the input
Set: All offset — sets the All offset knob to a named semitone interval or a named voltage
Set: Incremental offset — sets the incremental offset knob to a named semitone interval or a named voltage
Set: Offsets 1-8 — sets the eight knobs together to the degrees of a named scale or the notes of a named chord
Set: Offset 1, Set: Offset 2 and the rest up to Set: Offset 8 — sets that one knob to a named semitone interval or a named voltage
Quantize mode — rounds the output to the nearest step of the size chosen, from a twelfth of a volt up to 5V, and is Off unless you set it
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
